kevin: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight trace bucketization model to map traces into billing buckets. PTAL. TL;DR: hash(trace_id) -> bucket, annotate span with billing.bucket, emit a single cost-aggregate event per bucket.

maya: High level sounds reasonable. How do we handle cross-service traces that span multiple billing owners?

kevin: Plan: assign bucket at the ingest edge (API gateway) based on the primary resource/owner tag, propagate `billing.bucket` as a span attribute. If another service claims ownership, we apply a merge policy (see below).

nora: Concern: sampling. If services sample independently, bucket counts will diverge. Suggest deterministic sampling keyed by `billing.bucket + trace_id` so decisions are stable across the trace.

liam: That means sampler needs access to bucket id early. Any perf numbers for deterministic sampler?

kevin: Quick sim: deterministic sampler at gateway added ~0.6% CPU at p95 on our loadtest VM. Throughput impact negligible in canary. I can paste the test script later.

mira: What about the enrichment pipeline? Do we need an extra join/lookup later to reconcile buckets?

kevin: Prefer to avoid pipeline-side joins. Annotate at source so downstreams already have `billing.bucket`. Header we propose: `X-Trace-Bucket: rb-<hex>` and span attribute `billing.bucket: rb-<hex>`. Example:```http
POST /api/foo HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Trace-Bucket: rb-7f2a1c
Traceparent: 00-...
```
and span JSON: ```json
{ "trace_id": "f1e2d3...", "span_id": "a1b2c3", "attributes": { "billing.bucket": "rb-7f2a1c", "service.owner": "payments" } }
```

nora: Edge case: multi-tenant requests with no owner tag — how do we pick a bucket?

kevin: Fallbacks: 1) if org_id present use hashed(org_id + path) -> bucket; 2) else mark `billing.bucket: unknown` and route to a low-priority catch-all bucket for chargeback reconciliations. We still apply deterministic sampling in `unknown` so we keep counts comparable.

ops-bot: deploy 2148765440: gateway rollout (trace_bucketization_v1) started

liam: Deployment note: feature flag `trace_bucketization_v1` + canary at 5% traffic, monitor CPU, request latency, and bucket cardinality.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook and add a dashboard for bucket cardinality + unknown bucket trend.

kevin: Action items: 1) maya/nora -> draft merge-policy doc PR (how to reconcile conflicting owner claims) by EOD Thu; 2) liam -> feature-flag rollout plan and canary dashboard; 3) mira -> runbook + observability dashboard. Ping here when PRs are ready. Anyone object to approach?

maya: No objections. Small nit: include explicit mapping for `unknown` -> cost center in the doc (who owns billing for `unknown` transiently).

nora: ACK

kevin: Cool — thanks all. If no blockers I'll start the PRs and tag you for review.
